lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Toronto police identify suspect in violent Bridle Path home invasion, say he was also shot, The Canadian Press reports.
‘Associate’ EU membership for Canada not a ‘short-term’ project: expert, Global News reports.

Hundreds of thousands of mostly young protesters took to the streets across France on Saturday in a third consecutive weekend of demonstrations over living costs and education, The Associated Press reports.
Police are investigating a single-vehicle crash in Puslinch, just outside of Guelph, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
